sources.label: Official Sweaty Betty Size Guide (General Size Guide, cm; International Conversions)

audit: Same URL. General Size Guide prints bust/waist/hips per size in cm and inches (printed cm used, inches kept in _in); header 'UK Sizes' 6/XXS, 8/XS, 10/S, 12/M, 14/L, 16-18/XL, 18-20/XXL (XL and XXL both include 18, as printed). US and EU from the International Conversions table on the same page. Old UK mapping was one size off: old XS 'UK 6-8' 82/62/87 -> XXS UK 6 77/59/86 and XS UK 8 82/64/91; old M 'UK 10-12' 90/70/95 -> UK 12 92/74/101; old XXL 107/87/112 -> UK 18-20 109/91/118. XXS added. Leggings and Trousers charts print the same waist/hips.
